report.reading_scope: Read the official HTML mathematical introduction including (0.1)-(0.8), the (0.9) display and subsequent phase-speed sentence, all of sections 1.1-1.4, 2-2.2 and 3-3.4, displayed mathematical statements and textual figure captions. report.coverage_status: A narrative outline and 40 atomic knowledge pages, 4101-410F, 4110-411F and 4120-4128. All three main branches and every numbered open-problem group have narrative entrances. Formal report theorems 1.1,1.3,2.1,3.2,3.3 have dedicated pages; adjacent capillary KAM and pure-gravity quartic results remain explicitly scoped research remarks, not complete restatements of the underlying papers. Local checks and proof boundaries do not constitute independent final acceptance or publication.

proof_scope.4101: Defines the periodic Sobolev completion, zero-mean space, quotient by constants and inverse derivative. Uses existing Fourier/Sobolev atoms; does not reprove full Fourier completeness or elliptic theory.
proof_scope.4102: Defines unnormalized Dirichlet-Neumann data with unit normal and ds factor. Derives Green energy identity for smooth extensions; existence and regularity of the harmonic boundary problem are cited inputs.
proof_scope.4103: Complete separated-mode proof of finite/deep flat symbol, zero mode and Sobolev extension bound.
proof_scope.4104: States the constant-vorticity surface equations and derives mean-height conservation. Full reduction from Euler is cited.
proof_scope.4105: Defines energy and Poisson convention, reconciles sign with existing Hamilton geometry, proves smooth energy conservation. Shape differentiation of the nonlinear DNO remains external.
proof_scope.4106: Complete T J_gamma T*=J_0 calculation and gradient chain rule; Sterling diagram expresses the actual equality.
proof_scope.4107: Complete modal characteristic-polynomial and canonical-variable calculation, negative time exponent and signed phase speed. Covers j nonzero only.
proof_scope.4108: Defines time quasiperiodicity and proves the invariance equation yields whole-time trajectories on the chosen torus. No neighborhood global well-posedness conclusion.
proof_scope.4109: Proves parity invariance conditional on classical local uniqueness; harmonic extension uniqueness is an external PDE input.
proof_scope.4110: Quotes Theorem 2.1 with exact X^s shifts and quantifier order. General sufficiently small data, almost every strictly positive kappa, fixed N-dependent regularity and thresholds; no N-to-infinity passage.
proof_scope.4111: Complete energy-bootstrap implication under an explicit delta-neighborhood continuation criterion and epsilon<delta/(2 sqrt A). The PDE energy inequality itself is external.
proof_scope.4112: Complete finite-monomial Poisson bracket and homological denominator calculation. Does not prove convergence or boundedness of an infinite-dimensional normal-form transformation.
proof_scope.4113: Complete exclusion of nonzero three-wave resonances for infinite-depth irrotational pure gravity; direct positive-capillarity counterexample to unrestricted extension.
proof_scope.4114: Complete numerical four-wave resonance calculation. No inference that the corresponding interaction coefficient is nonzero.
proof_scope.4115: Complete algebraic superaction conservation and nonnegative-series Sobolev consequence, conditional on a defined Hamilton flow. Does not imply full integrability.
proof_scope.4116: Defines regularized Bony-Weyl matrix formula and verifies x-independent multiplier reduction. Symbolic calculus and tame remainder bounds remain external.
proof_scope.4117: Research proof architecture only: nonlinear regularization, finite-order symplectic correction and removal of non-superaction terms. Correctly identifies i times real multipliers as skew-adjoint.
proof_scope.4118: Defines Stokes branch and checks the linear first harmonic. Analytic branch existence and higher coefficients are cited classical results.
proof_scope.4119: Proves derivative shift, modulo-one Floquet equivalence and exact mu=m/N grid. Direct-integral spectral theorem is cited; individual Bloch waves are not claimed to lie in L2(R).
proof_scope.4120: Quotes a fixed-finite-order, generic finite-depth isola theorem; smallness may depend on order and fixed parameter range. No same-epsilon infinitely-many-isolas or infinite-depth extension. Nondegeneracy proof is external.
proof_scope.4121: Complete deep-water double-collision location calculation; no nonzero-amplitude splitting claim.
proof_scope.4122: Records report P1,1-P1,3 and distinguishes finite/infinite frequencies and periodic/quasiperiodic space. No new existence theorem or exhaustive current-literature claim.
proof_scope.4123: Records report P2,1-P2,4 and the nonuniform-in-N global gap. No new PDE theorem.
proof_scope.4124: Records report P3,1-P3,4, cited nonlinear instability and open invariant-manifold questions. Does not infer nonlinear instability from linear spectra alone.
proof_scope.4125: Research remark on quartic Hamilton versus cubic vector-field degree and epsilon^-3 lifespan. Underlying full initial-data theorem and exact minimal regularity are deliberately not restated.
proof_scope.4126: Research context for capillary KAM, using report references and a pinned abstract. Complete original parameter/regularity theorem is not restated.
proof_scope.4127: Defines a representative tame bound and proves Fourier smoothing inequalities. No abstract Nash-Moser convergence theorem is claimed.
proof_scope.4128: Complete simultaneous substitution into both linear equations determines the real traveling sine coefficient for either sign of j. This supplies the documented correction of report HTML (1.8).
proof_scope.410A: Proves continuous-time cohomological inversion with Sobolev loss. Defines water-wave Melnikov denominators; parameter measure estimates are not proved.
proof_scope.410B: Quotes report Theorem 1.1 with fixed positive xi followed by asymptotically full-measure depths, finite depth interval, zero tension/vorticity and finite high Sobolev regularity. Nash-Moser existence and normal reducibility are external.
proof_scope.410C: Defines quasiperiodic traveling profiles and proves the moving-frame obstruction for effective phase rank. Single-phase speed explicitly requires j_1 nonzero.
proof_scope.410D: Quotes report Theorem 1.3 for fixed depth and good vorticities, with explicit small positive amplitudes and distinct absolute wave numbers. Linear leading sine coefficients are corrected by the independent calculation in 4128; this is a source-internal correction, not a verified publisher erratum. Research existence proof remains external.
proof_scope.410E: Proof architecture only: pseudodifferential regularization, smoothing KAM diagonalization, tame inverse bounds, parameter exclusions and Nash-Moser closure. Does not apply finite-dimensional KAM directly to PDE.
proof_scope.410F: Defines periodic symbols, quantization and smoothing order; checks multiplier scale. Egorov and quantitative calculus are cited.
proof_scope.411A: Complete modal eigenvalue and algebraic zero-multiplicity calculation in the unreduced periodic space. Explains why zero-mode removal changes that calculation.
proof_scope.411B: Complete finite-dimensional Hamilton spectral-symmetry and simple-root argument. Unbounded-operator spectral reduction is cited with domain qualifications.
proof_scope.411C: Quotes the deep-water Benjamin-Feir eigenvalue expansion and endpoint signs from Theorem 3.2. Remainder control and block reduction are external; only longitudinal small-amplitude spectra are asserted.
proof_scope.411D: Complete eigenvalue and maximization calculation for the leading 2x2 model. Transfer of the asymptotic growth to PDE uses 411C.
proof_scope.411E: Quotes finite-depth and critical-depth research conclusions. Specifies the exact threshold by the Whitham-Benjamin coefficient, not just a decimal. No proof of coefficient zero uniqueness or critical high-order expansion.
proof_scope.411F: Defines finite-rank Riesz projection under finite algebraic multiplicity; projection identities and generalized eigenspace description are cited spectral results. Proves local rank preservation from uniform norm-resolvent continuity and nearby projections. Describes symplectic Kato/block method; distinguishes deep-water one-sided mu analyticity.
